nom: ANUA Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil Mild

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers are split: some report new blackheads or breakouts after adding this oil, while others say it helped control oil production and cleared their skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including sensitive-combo skin, generally like it for T-zone buildup and report soft, clean, non-stripped skin without breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers (including eczema-prone) mostly report no irritation, no stinging, and hydrated skin after use, with no breakouts described.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers describe skin left soft, clean, nourished and hydrated rather than stripped after rinsing.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with sensitive and eczema-prone skin reports no stinging or irritation, saying other 'clean' products often bothered her skin but this did not.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers say the product cleared clogged pores, blackheads and whiteheads with regular targeted massage; one reviewer with oily skin instead says she started getting blackheads she never had before.
concerns.blemishes: Accounts are mixed: multiple reviewers report their acne cleared or improved, including one describing it as helping a severe breakout, but several others report new or worsened breakouts, including one describing cystic acne and bumps around the mouth and chin after only two uses.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin mention using it to deep-clean and deal with feeling oily; one says it helped control her natural oil production.

aspects.libelle: Danger if it gets in eyes

extraits.titre: i wanted to love this so bad
extraits.texte: i tried the regular heartleaf cleansing oil but didn't repurchase because it does have fragrance. i heard about the mild version and was so confident it would be a good fit, however i immediately broke out and had to return it :( while it has a very short list of ingredients, it does contain rosemary oil which can potentitally be pore clogging if you have more acne prone skin like myself. didn't love but it's ok anua i still love you

This product completely ruined my skin. I only used it twice and broke out it cystic acne which ive never had before. This was such a painful time in my life onyop of that i had a bunch of white stuff around my mouth abd chin had to wear a mask everywhere bc it was disgusting 🤮 I went on tiktok to see if other people where experiencing the same thing and we all broke out in the sane area 🤦‍♀️ Thank God for estheticians

I have oily skin, really oily around the T zone, even since I added it to my routine I regret it so much!! My first mistake was putting anything oil related on my face... I never get blackheads on my face and all of a sudden I am getting them.

I looooove tbis stuff. I have combo skin and get build up in my T zone. I love using this on makeup days as a first step to double cleanse or on other days when I just feel oily or want to deep clean my pores. The oil really gets in there and dissolves all the little gunky stuff and gentlt exfoliates. Its so satisfying to use. Make sure to emulsify with water and rub in a bit more before removing. It leaves my skin feeling soooo soft, clean, nourished, and not stripped at all.

I loved this cleansing oil and it even removed all my waterproof make up! The best way I found was to do one pump of the cleanser and massage all over your face, and gently on the eyes, and then add a little bit of water. It emulsifies really well and removes everything. I really loved how it smelled clean, and there was no stinging or irritation on my sensitive skin a lot of times products that are " Clean "still irritate my try and eczema prone skin, but this did not. For the price I was very surprised at how great the results are! To me it feels and acts like a product you would find in a fancy day spa. I would definitely recommend this to my family and friends. This review was collected as part of a promotion

Ive been using this cleanser for around 4 months and absolutley love it. Easily removes makeup and i follow up with a foaming cleanser after (vanicream). I have sensitive combo skin and it does not cause me to break out.

I was struggling with an extreme acne breakout and ended up switching to this makeup cleanser because it was low friction. I was really scared at first because my skin is extremely oily and I thought it would make me break out more but it actually has helped me control my natural oil production, cleared my skin and has made my face super soft! Very thankful I found this product and I'm considering trying their face moisturizer aswell.
